metadata.title: नेटवर्क की तलाश में भटकता आदिवासी | No network coverage makes life difficult for Adivasi
metadata.description: The digital revolution in India has led to a significant transformation in the way citizens access services, resulting in improved efficiency, transparency, and accountability. This shift to digital platforms has streamlined government processes, saving time and energy for people while curbing corruption and ensuring timely service delivery. Particularly in rural areas, the integration of digital services has effectively plugged leaks in various welfare schemes, benefitting marginalized communities such as the Adivasi population. However, despite these advancements, challenges remain in remote tribal regions like Madhya Pradesh, where the lack of reliable internet networks and mobile signals hinders the full realization of these benefits. Bridging the connectivity gap in such areas is crucial to ensuring that the advantages of digital services reach every corner of the country.
